about.title: About the Scarlet & Violet set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 31 March 2023. It has 258 cards: 198 in the main set and 60 secret rares. For a master set there are also 186 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 198 main set cards), the Complete set (all 258 cards) or the Master set (444 cards, adding every reverse holos).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
